entities.name: Nikolaus von Falkenhorst
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paul Nikolaus von Falkenhorst was a German general and war criminal during World War II. He planned and commanded the German invasion of Denmark and Norway in 1940, and was commander of German troops during the occupation of Norway from 1940 to 1944.
